# Cineview runtime

This is the actual Cineview 2.0.1 runtime from [AlienMu/cineview](https://github.com/AlienMu/cineview), source commit `3cd988430539b71ae864bef69dd01136e356ba56`.

The source TypeScript was transpiled with Node 24's built-in `node:module.stripTypeScriptTypes` (transform mode). Relative module specifiers received explicit `.js` extensions, and the upstream production constant `__DEV__` was set to `false`. No framework behavior was replaced. The shipped boot stylesheet and head script were generated by the upstream `bootCss()` and `HEAD_SNIPPET` exports.

The modules are deliberately unbundled and self-hosted, including lazy feature modules. Load `head.js` (inline), `cineview.css`, then `cineview.js` as a module, as prescribed by Cineview.

MIT license retained in LICENSE.
